phase: Phase 1A — freeze planning contracts before any metric authoring
purpose: Freeze the SIX closed vocabularies and their transition invariants used by the Honda Semantic Watchdog. Design-only: no metric rows authored here. Each vocabulary is a CLOSED set (any value outside it is a fail-closed contract error). This file is the machine-authoritative home for the disposition vocabulary amended by SPEC_AMENDMENT_001 (item 1).

authority.spec: docs/halo/planning/HONDA_SEMANTIC_WATCHDOG_EXECUTION_SPEC.md (reviewed, byte-pinned; sha256 fedd957b…) — §3 disposition/boundary, §6 threshold/reference/target, §7 InfoStore states, §8 module partitions

values.sales: In-envelope Honda Sales. The only class eligible for value/grade/narrative/customer projection.
values.separate_serra_service: Service/Parts — separately governed combined Serra Service workspace. Never enters Honda Sales. Disposition-only; appendix projects ID + neutral label + no value.
values.cross_rooftop_authorization: Requires cross-rooftop authorization; outside Honda Sales until separately authorized.
values.compliance_pii_authorization: Requires compliance/PII authorization envelope; disposition-only until authorized.
values.external_noncrm: Data outside VinSolutions/CRM; external source named and required.

measured_validated.desc: Real source, accepted calculation, accepted baseline/evaluation where applicable.

data_acquired_calculation_pending.desc: Governed source exists locally, but transformation/evaluation is unfinished.

crm_available_acquisition_pending.desc: Required field proved in VinSolutions but not yet acquired.

additional_history_required.desc: Field and method proved, but the required trailing/cohort window has not accumulated.

external_source_required.desc: Data is outside VinSolutions and the source is named.

genuinely_not_available.desc: Source investigation PROVED the required event/field/history is not obtainable. Requires affirmative finite-investigation evidence.

outside_sales_domain.desc: Service, Parts, cross-rooftop, compliance/PII, or other separately governed work.

source_investigation_pending.desc: AMENDMENT_001 state #8 (nonterminal). Sales source EXISTENCE is unproved — a finite investigation is required before any other disposition may be asserted.

context_receipts.__comment: Certain transitions require an affirmative context receipt (a named evidence ref), not prose. Keys are 'from->to'; each lists the required receipt field(s) in the transition context.

calculation_kind.spec_ref: SPEC §5.4/§5.5/§6 — frozen closed set of calculation kinds

values.rate: Ratio numerator/denominator (share, conversion, %). Requires an explicit zero-denominator behavior.
values.duration: Elapsed-time measure (e.g., minutes to first touch).
values.direct: Direct passthrough of a delivered field (no derived formula).
values.semantic: Content/NLP-derived output; requires the protected-content envelope and abstention semantics.

source_existence_state.spec_ref: SPEC §5 (source-first), §7.1 — frozen for Phase 1A source registry

values.investigation_pending: A finite investigation is open (pairs with disposition source_investigation_pending).
values.proved_available_in_crm: Source/field proved present in VinSolutions, not yet acquired.
values.acquired_local: Sales-clean raw bytes acquired to the Honda landing.
values.proved_requires_external: Proved the data requires a named external (non-CRM) source.
values.proved_requires_more_history: Proved the field/method exists but the trailing/cohort window has not accumulated.
values.proved_not_available: Finite investigation proved not obtainable (basis for genuinely_not_available).

values.measured_unscored: Observation persisted but not graded (gradable=false, unresolved grade target, or measured-unscored layer e.g. Response Times).
values.measured_graded: Observation persisted and graded against the one approved grade target.
values.measured_abstained: Content/semantic output abstained due to low confidence (never a measured fact).

disposition_evaluation_consistency.spec_ref: SPEC §3/§6 — frozen exact disposition -> allowed evaluation_state map (only measured_validated / data_acquired_calculation_pending may leave not_measured)

source_existence_acquisition_matrix.spec_ref: SPEC §5/§7.1 — frozen allowed (source_existence_state, acquisition_admission_state) pairs; all others reject

acquisition_admission_state.spec_ref: SPEC §5, §7.1, §7.3 — frozen closed set (per source artifact)

values.acquisition_pending: Acquisition task open for the dedupe key.
values.acquired_pending_admission: Bytes acquired; in neutral pre-admission inspection.
values.quarantined: Contaminated/failed classifier; TERMINAL for the artifact; routed to segregated pre-admission vault; writes zero analytical rows.
values.acquisition_exception: Missing/failed delivery; opens a visible source-run exception; creates no empty observations.

report_acceptance_state.spec_ref: SPEC §8, §7.10, §7.12 — frozen closed set (module subsection / report run)

values.accepted: Impartial-shadow pass; measured IDs only feed grades/narrative.
values.rejected: Failed review; blocks final completion until corrected or converted to an allowed disposition.
values.withheld_no_delivery: Assembled but intentionally not delivered (Honda goal sends nothing to customers).
